description: For organizers leaving Meetup: paste the group's name, its description and its schedule (one event per line) and get a 4-week plan. Includes a ready Tribe description, one-tap weekly outing drafts for each recurring event, and an announcement to post to members. Uses only the text provided; it never accesses Meetup or member data.

about.description: The group's description, pasted from its Meetup page.

activity.description: Main activity, if the schedule lines don't say.

schedule.description: One event per line, e.g. "Saturdays 8am hike at Warriors Path\nThursdays 6pm run from Founders Park".

name: move_from_meetup
title: Move a Group from Meetup
